cadence_policy.content: Cadence Policy v4 (effective 2026-01-01). Four-touch sequence: Day 0 intro -> Day 3 value follow-up -> Day 7 case-study -> Day 14 break-up. A lead is 'due' when the gap between today and last touch meets or exceeds the interval to the next step (3, 4, and 7 business days respectively). Leads with status 'Reply Received - On Hold' are NEVER advanced automatically and must be handled by the rep. After the Day 14 break-up, the lead exits the active sequence. Minimum 2 business days must separate any two outreach emails to the same lead.

outreach_playbook.content: Sales Outreach Playbook. Personalization checklist: confirm company name spelling, reference one specific pain point per industry, keep emails under 120 words, single clear CTA. Escalation: any lead mentioning procurement, legal, or security must be routed to the AE before further automated touches. Do not over-mail accounts with open opportunities.

tools.name: get_drip_campaign_leads

tools.name: get_cadence_templates
tools.description: Retrieve the outreach email templates for each cadence step so the correct next-step template can be selected per lead.

tools.name: get_lead_engagement_log
tools.description: Retrieve recent engagement events (opens, clicks, replies, holds) for the active leads to inform personalization and eligibility.

tools.name: evaluate_cadence_due_status
tools.description: Apply the cadence policy and the sales calendar to compute, for each lead, whether it is due for its next touch, which next step it would advance to, and whether any hold or escalation rule blocks advancement.

tools.name: draft_drip_campaign_batch
tools.description: Compose the personalized next-step outreach emails for the due leads using the correct cadence templates, and assemble an advancement summary (who would move to which step) into a draft batch for the user to review and approve.

tools.name: enroll_lead_in_next_step
tools.description: Advance a lead to its next cadence step in the campaign automation system, scheduling and committing the next touch.
